parallel_timing_and_resources.basis: recomputed from invocation start/end, common job start and evaluation timestamps
parallel_timing_and_resources.interpretation: W38 under the two-by-eight layout observed about 1.305x aggregate sample throughput, not two times and not eight updates on one policy. Controller, reward and trajectory changes prevent isolating the gain as a parallel-layout causal effect. Both streams overlap for nearly the entire training span. Per-stream planning dominates about 88% of episode wall. No measured evidence establishes that two-by-ten workers is faster or safe against framework thread contention.
parallel_timing_and_resources.next_resource_choice: Retain the observed 2x8 setting unless a separately justified implementation/resource change needs 2x10. Do not introduce a worker grid or standalone benchmark. 20 solver workers would leave five of 25 allocated vCPU for both runtime/RPC/framework/I/O processes; actual internal thread counts/utilization were not measured.

reward_reconstruction.method: R_episode = 5*final_legal_progress - simulation_s/60 - indentation_integral/60 - slip_integral/600 - .01*sum((new_applied_cap-old_applied_cap)/.035)^2 +10*legal_roundtrips -10*physical_failure. First applied cap is .25 before outbound; actor decisions during initial stand are not applied until outbound starts.

reward_reconstruction.W38_scope_limit: This provides undiscounted episode returns and reward-component totals, not observed per-transition rewards, GAE values, or per-update reward means. Those are explicitly null/unavailable.
reward_reconstruction.terminal_settlement_conclusion: All 68 true physical terminals have a recorded settlement and zero final legal credit; 67 retract positive credit, while w38-b ep218 already lost credit on a side exit. The two target truncations do not receive physical settlement. The source performs settlement before the final collect_pending.
reward_reconstruction.causal_limit: Correct terminal accounting did not produce legal task success. No claim that reward cancellation is the physical cause of the residual falls or nonfoot contact.

data_and_metadata_findings.finding: Low-rate training/evaluation transitions and original observations are not in the W38 compact job directories. PANN per-update counts, actual per-transition reward cancellation and GAE cannot be independently audited from this checkout.
data_and_metadata_findings.minimal_followup: Publish existing low-rate transition files or equivalent compact rows under each job, plus per-update nonzero PANN counts computed from retained local rollouts. No new physics, bulk checkpoint/video upload or monitoring framework is needed.

data_and_metadata_findings.finding: AGENTS.md and S5-r27 build spec retain joint_sampling_running/startup qualification wording. The fixed HEAD job/collection/evaluation records show both computations ended. Actual records take precedence.
job.training.controller_migration is inherited r25->r26 history. Current r26 ep216 -> r27 fork identity is saved in each collection; do not infer a repeated ep144 restoration or re-exclude 145.

w38-b ep251 stops at 2.0 s before outbound at the sample target. Its tiny max x is not recurrence of r25 startup regression. Both ep251 target truncations must be excluded from natural-failure lifetime trends.

Within each stream all result configuration/execution fingerprints remain constant, and both streams record the same r27 binary. Different seed/stream fingerprints across forks are expected identity differences, not evidence of changed physics.

Both jobs are published compact_git with no errors or pending assets. All 72 actual training/evaluation attempts have results and no initialization failure records. Raw data remains local and automatic cleanup is disabled; publication does not prove user backup.

next_experiment_implications: Do not claim convergence or choose a qualified winner: each branch has four new updates, both final E30 fail before strip entry, and neither branch has any legal traversal/return.

A smoothing of the artificial spatial risk gate plus terminal reward settlement is insufficient to solve the task. Training shows somewhat more entry than W37 but no deeper maximum reach or late-learning improvement; merely repeating the same two-by-1024 schedule has low diagnostic value.

Use existing event-window data to locate the earliest rigid-approach posture/support or feedback loss before changing the controller. New planner/feedback diagnostic logs are referenced by resolved records but not present in compact Git; do not assert a newly observed K spike without reading those retained logs.

Keep the full joint loop, original material .02 domain, torque/contact/fall/route rules and last-update E30/E60 selection. Do not relax thresholds or add isolated-MPC/rigid admission tests, an attempt cap, or parameter/worker matrices.

PANN remains sparsely exposed and there is no return history. Same-state feature zeroing changes none of the 56 evaluation caps; this supports no observed local action effect on these trajectories, not a general claim that material memory cannot help.
Retain 2x8 for comparable observed resource use unless the next justified change explicitly requires otherwise; no data currently support a promised gain from 2x10.
